title: Flexible onboarding allowances and timed conversion nudges
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Objective: Validate whether a time-phased onboarding allowance (variable free credits with staged expiration) plus contextual conversion nudges increases activation and paid conversion while keeping marginal inference cost within threshold.

Background: Prior credit experiments showed lift on short-term engagement but unclear long-term conversion and cost leakage from large unstructured allowances. This experiment combines two ideas: (1) split the initial free allowance into buckets with staggered expirations to encourage progressive engagement, and (2) surface contextual upgrade nudges tied to usage patterns rather than a static banner. We aim to find a durable configuration that balances product value, PLG flow, and unit economics for hosted inference.

Hypothesis: Users receiving a staggered allowance (e.g., 5k tokens immediate + 15k tokens expiring at 14 days + 30k tokens expiring at 60 days) plus targeted in-app prompts at predefined usage milestones will show a 20% relative increase in 30-day paid conversion compared to control, without exceeding a 15% increase in average cost-per-new-customer for the hosted API tier.

Success metrics: 30d paid conversion rate (primary), 7d activation (users with >=1 successful generation), median time-to-first-paid, cost-per-acquisition (marginal inference token cost normalized), churn at 90d. Secondary: retention of embedding-heavy workflows and sign-up -> active API key issuance time.

Experiment structure and variants: Variant A (Control): current single-bucket allowance (existing free credits).
Variant B: Split allowance: 5k immediate / 15k expires in 14d / 30k expires in 60d.
Variant C: Same as B but with periodic in-app nudges: milestone cards at 1k tokens, 10k tokens, and last-7-days warning before expiry. Nudges include tailored CTAs (upgrade to Dedicated, purchase pay-as-you-go pack, or extend trial).
Variant D: Larger immediate bucket (25k immediate) with no staged expirations but with nudges.

Instrumentation: Events to capture: credits_awarded (bucket_id), credits_consumed (tokens, model, route), nudge_shown (nudge_id, variant), nudge_click, upgrade_flow_started, purchase_completed, api_key_issued, inference_cost_estimate_at_signup. Tag all events with attribution (experiment_id, variant, cohort).

Data queries and dashboards: Link to experiment dashboard (bigquery): https://analytics.redwood.com/datasets/bq/projects/plg/experiments/PM-22456_dashboard (placeholder). Mixpanel funnel: https://mixpanel.com/project/redwood/plg/onboarding. Cost breakdown workbook: https://docs.redwood.com/spreadsheets/costs/pm-22456.

Rollout plan: 1) Internal QA and compliance review (week 1) — feature flags and cost guardrails. 2) 1% seeded rollout to new sign-ups + seed existing low-usage accounts for 2 weeks (safety). 3) Ramp to 10% for 2 weeks while monitoring cost alerts. 4) If no cost breach and positive activation lift, increase to 25% for statistical power. 5) Full rollout contingent on legal/security sign-off and finance ROI check.

Dependencies: billing team for tokenized cost attribution, Console engineering to implement staged expiration semantics, Growth engineering for in-app prompts, Analytics for instrumentation, Legal for updated trial terms.

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: Large immediate allowances drive high short-term cost without conversion. Mitigation: cost guardrail triggers that pause variant if marginal CPA exceeds threshold; cap per-account token burn rate.
- Risk: Nudges create poor UX if mis-targeted. Mitigation: limited frequency, A/B test nudge copy and placement, collect qualitative feedback via quick in-product survey.
- Risk: Enterprise customers misinterpret staged expiry as non-viable product. Mitigation: enterprise onboarding excludes experiment by default and a separate sales outreach playbook is prepared.

Compliance / security notes: Because staged expiry changes credit lifecycle, legal updated TOS required and security review flagged due to token attribution metadata. Security review ticket: SEC-4412 (referenced).

Attachments and artifacts: Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PLG/PM-22456, design mocks (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pm-22456-onboarding-nudges, experiment analysis sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/spreadsheets/pm-22456-analysis.
